supporting_objects.name: U_TIME_MS

inputs.name: THICKNESS_FAULT
inputs.description: Thickness deviation exceeds the permitted tolerance.

inputs.name: THICKNESS_SIGNAL_VALID
inputs.description: Thickness-signal validity; FALSE means the signal is lost or unavailable.

inputs.name: FaultTimestamp
inputs.description: Current timestamp in seconds, used as the fault-record identifier.

inputs.name: CycleTime
inputs.description: Actual elapsed interval represented by this invocation; must be positive.

outputs.name: THICKNESS_ALARM
outputs.description: Thickness alarm with a minimum 500 ms hold duration.

outputs.name: Slab_Fault_History
outputs.description: Five most recent fault timestamps; index 0 is newest; read-only to callers.
